# -------------------------------------------------------
# RULE 1: Block deployment on compliance test failures
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Tests tagged with "compliance" should NEVER be skipped
# or marked as xfail. A failure in these tests means
# regulatory reporting is broken.
#
# Recommended pytest marker:
#   @pytest.mark.compliance
#
# CI config (GitHub Actions example):
#
#   - name: Run compliance-critical tests
#     run: python -m pytest -m compliance --strict-markers --tb=short
#     continue-on-error: false   # BLOCK deployment
#
# Tests to tag:
#   - test_structuring_at_reporting_line
#   - test_structuring_just_below_threshold
#   - test_structuring_compliance_flag
#   - test_rapid_succession_high_velocity
#   - test_rapid_succession_boundary

# -------------------------------------------------------
# RULE 2: Unit conversion assertions in shared helpers
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Any function that converts time units should include
# a sanity assertion:
#
#   def compute_time_span_hours(self, chain):
#       ...
#       hours = delta_seconds / 3600
#       assert hours < 8760, "Time span > 1 year -- likely unit error"
#       return hours
#
# This catches /60 vs /3600 bugs at runtime.
